index 0000000..66ab92c
--- /dev/null
+++ b/test/units/executor/test_display_queue.py
@@ -0,0 +1,34 @@
+from __future__ import absolute_import, division, print_function
+
+from queue import Queue
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+from ansible.executor.task_queue_manager import DisplaySend, FinalQueue
+from ansible.plugins.strategy import StrategySentinel, results_thread_main
+
+
+def test_final_queue_sends_display():
+    final_q = FinalQueue()
+    try:
+        final_q.send_display(u'hello', stderr=True, newline=False)
+        result = final_q.get(timeout=5)
+        assert isinstance(result, DisplaySend)
+        assert result.args == (u'hello',)
+        assert result.kwargs == {'stderr': True, 'newline': False}
+    finally:
+        final_q.close()
+        final_q.join_thread()
+
+
+def test_results_thread_replays_all_displays(capsys, mocker):
+    mocker.patch('ansible.utils.display.logger', None)
+    final_q = Queue()
+    final_q.put(DisplaySend(u'first'))
+    final_q.put(DisplaySend(u'second', stderr=True, newline=False))
+    final_q.put(StrategySentinel())
+
+    results_thread_main(SimpleNamespace(_final_q=final_q))
+
+    captured = capsys.readouterr()
+    assert captured.out == 'first\n'
+    assert captured.err == 'second'
